NITY. FAMILIO L. YULO 111 Sangguniang Panlalawigan Member 5th District, Negros Occidental Dear Atty. Yulo III: This has reference to your letter dated 3() January 2013 requesting this Department to harmonize the interpretation of Section 323 of the Local Government Code of 1991 vis-å-vis the Legal Opinion rendered by Regional Director Evelyn A. Trompeta, DILG Region VI, specifically on the prohibition of taking up "other business" during the extended sessions in enacting the budget ordinance. In DILG RO 6 Opinion No. 01 series of 2013, Regional Director Evelyn A. Trompeta opined that the Sanggunian may take up other business during the extended sessions, especially in consideration of the exigency and importance of the other business, based on the use of the permissive word "may" in Section 323 of the Local Government Code of 1991. Coming now to your instant query, please be advised that in DILG Opinion No. 3 s. 2013 addressed to Governor Alfredo G. Marafion, that province, we have already answered the same issue. A copy of said opinion is hereto attached for your reference. In the aforementioned opinion, we clarified that Section 323 of the LGC of 1991 is clear that if the sanggunian concerned fails to pass an ordinance approving the annual budget, it shall continue to hold sessions, until such ordinance is approved and no other business may be taken up during such sessions. Basic is the rule in statutory construction that where the language of the law is clear, it must be applied according to its express terms (Azarcon vs. Sandiganbayan, 268 SCRA 747, February 26, 1997; Ramirez vs. CA, 248 SCRA 590, September 28, 1995). AVVhile we agree that the operations and basic services of your LGU should not be hampered or affected by the failure of the sanggunian to pass your budget ordinance, we are of the view that no other business may be taken up during extended sessions until such time that the annual appropriation ordinance is enacted and approved.

We hope to have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, JESUS B DO UEIV Director III Copy furnished: RI) Evelyn A. Trompeta DILG Region VI 6 Parola St., Fort San Pedro Iloilo City Legal:12/Mer1e
